text:
Maya: Quick thread — Mosaic Labs pilot finished. Theyre open to a written case + gated demo. Need a hero quote + signed release before we do any social.

Evan: They reported a 6x speedup on nightly ETL inference and ~28% lower per-request cost. Can we confirm exact public phrasing?

Kenji (Mosaic Labs): Confirmed. We can share the benchmark workbook under NDA. Prefer 'approximately 28%' publicly. Happy to co-run a 30-min on-demand demo.

Priyanka (Legal): Please paste the exact quote and upload the workbook. We'll add the data-source sentence and an embargo option to the release. Also require translation approval if localizing.

Maya: Draft hero: "Mosaic Labs achieved a 6x nightly inference speedup and approximately 28% lower per-request cost during our pilot." Thoughts?

Priyanka (Legal): '6x' + 'approximately 28%' ok if workbook attached. Need measurement window in release text: "Benchmarking conducted over a 21-day pilot; data provided by Mosaic Labs under NDA." Also include a signature block for the customer's legal signatory.

Kenji (Mosaic Labs): 21-day window is correct. We'll upload the workbook and arrange for VP sign-off. We prefer a 7-day embargo after publish.

Hannah (Growth): If embargo is 7 days, we'll schedule the gated demo email cadence to go out at T+7. Also request SFDC campaign + lead routing to go live at publish. @sales-ops can you set that up?

sales-ops: Yep. I can create the SFDC campaign and webhook. Need the publish date and the campaign name.

Evan: Plan: 1) get signed release + workbook, 2) legal finalizes redline, 3) marketing drafts short blog + gated demo page, 4) sales adds SFDC campaign and routing. Target publish two weeks from signed release.

Kenji (Mosaic Labs): Uploading workbook now: https://share.mosaic/benchmarks/redwood-21d.xlsx (access granted). VP will sign today.

Priyanka (Legal): Uploaded a quick redline with data-source and embargo language: https://legal.redwood/redlines/6112345678. Small note: remove 'may be used in advertising' unless the customer checks the box.

Maya: Great. Once signed release is in, I'll open a copy-approval thread (hero + 3 bullets + gated CTA) and include the SFDC campaign ID. Hannah, can you draft the gated demo landing copy?

Hannah (Growth): Yup — I'll draft the landing and nurture steps. Draft incoming tomorrow 9am PT.

sales-ops: Creating SFDC campaign now. Will post CAM-9201 in the approvals thread once created.

Kenji (Mosaic Labs): Signed release uploaded to the shared folder. Looking forward to the write-up and on-demand demo. :handshake:

Priyanka (Legal): Marking redline resolved after I see the signed PDF. :white_check_mark:

Maya: Perfect — thanks everyone. I'll schedule the internal pre-call before the recording and then move to approvals.
